en: Color image with scalloped white border showing a large medieval brick city gate with two massive round towers topped by steep blue-grey conical roofs. Between the towers is a richly ornamented Gothic brick façade with multiple arched windows and decorative gables, forming an arched passageway through the structure. In the foreground is a manicured park with lawns, flower beds full of yellow and red flowers, paths, and benches where people sit and walk, suggesting a touristic setting on a sunny day.
